hero.title: Edge AI Visual Radar
hero.subtitle: Transform any standard computer into an intelligent visual radar system. Edge-based algorithms process video streams directly on your existing hardware — no expensive GPUs, no cloud dependency.

intro.title: What Is Visual Radar?
intro.p1: AI-VisionRada is an edge-computing visual intelligence platform developed by Shenzhen Nuolan Yilu Technology. It turns ordinary computers into powerful visual radar systems that monitor, analyze, and respond to events in real time.
intro.p2: Unlike NVIDIA-based large model solutions that require expensive hardware and cloud subscriptions, our software runs on standard x86 machines. Edge algorithms process video streams locally, eliminating bandwidth costs and latency — while delivering enterprise-grade detection and alerting.

how.title: How It Works
how.step1Desc: Plug your existing cameras or video streams into any standard computer via network switch. No specialized hardware needed.
how.step2Desc: Edge AI algorithms analyze every frame in real time. Object detection, motion tracking, intrusion zones — all processed locally.
how.step3Desc: Define custom alert rules for specific events. When something happens, the system triggers instant notifications, recordings, or automated responses.

about.p1: Based in Shenzhen, China's hardware and AI capital, we specialize in edge-computing computer vision solutions. Our mission is to democratize AI-powered video intelligence — making it affordable and practical for businesses of every size.
about.p2: We believe powerful visual AI should not require million-dollar GPU clusters. Our edge algorithms deliver the same detection quality on standard hardware, at a fraction of the cost.
